items.title: A one-point DM Noetherian reduced stack admits a surjective etale morphism from the spectrum of a field

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a DM, locally Noetherian, reduced algebraic stack whose space is a single point admits a surjective etale morphism from the spectrum of a field (author lemma at source lines 4405-4410, label lemma-DM-residual-gerbe). The proof (source lines 4412-4545) chooses a smooth presentation, makes its diagonal etale, deduces unramifiedness of the comparison morphism to the presentation, produces a finite separable residue field extension at a closed point of an etale cover, and concludes etaleness on an open neighbourhood by the slice lemma and the local criterion for etaleness (proof lines 4412-4544). The residue field computation and the slice argument are the substance. H3.
